📒 **known issue recurrence** — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
Occurrence **#130** overall (resurfacing on the 10× cadence) · **47** occurrences in the last 7 days.

runtime-core-api RTC Screen Load p95 hit **11.06s @22:12Z** (Action 6.23s @22:11Z) vs the 3s threshold — latency-only, 0 errors, 0 backend 5XX, self-recovered within minutes. A second RTC burst (5.59s @22:31Z) followed at 22:34Z on #alert-system (grouped separately, suppressed). Co-fired with tonight's ki-21 frontend-XHR bursts → shared-upstream per the precedence note.

fix_status: **investigating** · no Jira yet.
Playbook: spike confirmed via DD metric ✓, latency-only confirmed ✓ → next is APM: inspect outlier traces >5s in the spike window for the dominant slow span (SQL / Mongo / Redis SCAN) by `@account_name`. Mitigations pending root cause: raise threshold to 4s (masks) / per-resource circuit breaker / targeted index fixes.

Source alerts (1 in this group):
  • https://method-team.slack.com/archives/C063V5HTTFU/p1781129459022019  (alert-runtime-monitoring, 22:10 UTC)

Evidence:
  • DD RTC Screen monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/115456700
  • DD RTC Action monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/117279738
  • APM outlier traces: https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service%3Aruntime-core-api%20%40duration%3A%3E5s

🚨 **new alert — needs human**  (score: 4)
Channel: alert-runtime-monitoring  •  bug-type guess: unknown  •  alerts in group: 3

**Symptoms:**
  - 3 alerts on #alert-runtime-monitoring at 00:14 / 00:35 / 00:57 UTC (regular ~21-min cadence)
  - Every queryable golden signal was **healthy** in the window: RTC Screen p95 max 1.75s, Action p95 max 1.77s, full-service runtime-core p95 max 1.52s (none > 3s); throughput normal (76–325 hits/min); 0 status:error logs.

Trace IDs: none captured (no error/slow traces in window)
Likely cause: **undetermined** — looks like a flapping or recovery-noise monitor, or a check not surfaced via APM traces. Flagged only because group-size-3 + novelty cleared the escalation threshold; confidence is low (0.40).
Suggested next action: **investigate / file defect** — identify which #alert-runtime-monitoring monitor (bot B063S8NBW0M) fired 3× overnight. The alert text is blocks-only (empty over the Slack MCP) so the bot can't name it; a human glance at the 00:14Z post resolves it in seconds.

  • DD metric (runtime-core p95 — healthy in window): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request
  • Kibana: URL unavailable (runtime-core APM is the signal here; no ES exception in window)

_Cycle note: this cleared an 18-alert / 8-group backlog after the hourly cron was stuck ~13h (last poll 2026-06-10 22:16Z)._

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence **#380** (all-time) — surfacing on the **every-10th-occurrence** rule (otherwise inside the 24h suppression window; last DM 2026-06-10 21:14Z). ~80 incident-log entries in the last 7 days. Still chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05; no Jira on file.

*What fired:* Monitor 77419271 "Unusual number of XHR errors for account" (#alert-frontend-errors, 4 alerts 15:10–15:21Z, last_triggered 15:21:12Z, now recovered/OK).

*Investigation (this window):* 108 distinct accounts (200-sample capped), all status_code:0 client-side XHR failures on /gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/{account}/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync. Top: redeagleinternational (8), mobilitycityofchicago (6), progressivewestman3 (6). Zero backend 5XX over threshold (monitor 70171778 last fired 2026-06-10). Steady-state chronic fan-out (~91–108 baseline), not an outage.

*Shared-upstream co-fire:* ki-24 also fired this window — runtime-core RTC p95 burst (Screen Load 16.81s / Action Execution 13.32s @15:54:00Z, recovered). Treat as shared-upstream signal per precedence_notes.

Source alerts (4): p1781190613949069, p1781190733907289, p1781191092778269, p1781191273403209 (#alert-frontend-errors)
Evidence: DD monitor 77419271; DD logs XHR errors.
